summary: The study focuses on the Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of high-k dielectrics such as Al2O3 and HfO2 on GaAs substrates. It examines the effects of different precursors, surface preparation methods, and ALD process types (thermal and plasma-enhanced) on the growth characteristics and interface quality. The research highlights the importance of surface preparation and precursor selection in achieving high-quality dielectric layers and mitigating interface defects. The study also explores the relationship between interface states and Fermi level pinning in III/V compound semiconductors.
